 Everything Coming To Apple TV In November 2026: Full List Of Movies & TV Shows
 By   Ryan Schwartz 
 Oct. 27, 2026 9:52 am EST 
 Apple TV 
 Add TVLine on Google: 
 Preferred Source 
 Google Discover 
 What's coming to Apple TV in November 2026? TVLine has rounded up the streamer's upcoming English-language releases, including new and returning series, original movies, and other notable premieres.
 Organized below by release date, the guide is designed to help subscribers see what's new, what's returning, and what's worth adding to their watchlists.
 For a broader look at what's premiering across television and streaming, check out our complete November 2026 What to Watch guide , which also includes a printable TV calendar. And for those looking specifically for new Christmas movies, our What to Watch: Holiday Edition offers a dedicated, comprehensive guide to this season's festive premieres.
 If you'd like a recommended watchlist delivered to your inbox each morning, you can sign up for TVLine's free What to Watch newsletter here . 
 PRINTABLE NOVEMBER TV CALENDAR 
 WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4
 📺 "Brothers" Season 1 finale 
📺 "Small Prophets" Season 1 finale
📺 "Stick" Season 2 (two-episode premiere)
 FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 6
 📺 " Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook " (original series)
Awkwafina embarks on a cross-country culinary road trip to sharpen her cooking skills and revive her family's beloved Chinese restaurant in Flushing, New York, with help from acclaimed chefs and restaurateurs.
 📺 "Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars" Season 2 finale
 FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13
 📺 " 12 12 12 " (original series, two-episode premiere)
Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan star as a disgraced FBI agent and career criminal, respectively, locked in a cat-and-mouse game surrounding a daring bank heist in Zurich.
 📺 " Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy " (original special)
Snoopy lands on Santa's naughty list and has just 12 days to prove he's a good beagle, discovering along the way that Christmas is about more than presents.
 🎥 " Being Heumann " (original movie)
Disability rights activist Judy Heumann (Ruth Madeley) leads a coalition of protesters in the longest occupation of a federal building in American history, refusing to leave until a government bureaucrat (Mark Ruffalo) takes action.
 WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 25
 🎥 " Way of the Warrior Kid " (original movie)
A bullied middle schooler (Jude Hill) gets a crash course in courage and confidence when his uncle (Chris Pratt), a decorated Navy SEAL, moves in for the summer and puts him through a training program inspired by his military experience; Linda Cardellini co-stars.
